##### Project general facts

Privé Residence by Ginco Properties is a beautifully conceived residential building where nature meets urban living, offering a private, statement address defined by comfort and ease surrounded by luxury. The project brings together 225 units in a well-judged mix of studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, alongside retail outlets at ground level for effortless everyday convenience. Open floor plans, smooth elegant lines and generous balconies create a genuine urban oasis, with park-view homes that turn tranquil green surroundings into part of daily life.

World-class amenities and signature facilities deliver an exceptional experience, from a sparkling swimming pool and a relaxed gazebo to a world-class gym, a serene yoga studio and steam and sauna rooms where the stress of a long day simply melts away. Families are wonderfully well served by bright, cheerful kids' play areas designed to stir the young imagination, with a high priority placed on hygiene and safety so little ones are always safe and happy. A generous BBQ area, an inviting one-kilometre park, a pet-friendly policy and a huge, beautifully laid-out lobby that doubles as a perfect setting for casual meetings and socialising complete an offering full of fun, entertainment and endless possibilities.

Inside, a classy finish and aesthetic decor come together to create interiors that feel calm, contemporary and effortlessly elegant. Thoughtfully planned layouts make excellent use of every space, with well-appointed kitchens, comfortable bedrooms fitted with generous built-in wardrobes and storage, and balconies that draw in light and greenery. Quality materials, appliances and fittings run throughout the building, from the warm timber tones and soft neutral palette of the apartments to the polished stone and refined lighting of the lobby and lift lobbies.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, it represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design.

At the heart of Dubai Hills is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

Dubai Hills is not just a residential development - it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation.
